content: FTC v DoNotPay: final order Feb 2025 (complaint Sept 2024, Operation AI Comply). FTC said DoNotPay did not test whether its AI lawyer operated to the level of a human lawyer and did not hire or retain attorneys to test the quality and accuracy of its law-related features. Order: 193,000 USD monetary relief, notice to 2021-2023 subscribers, ban on claiming the service performs like a real lawyer without substantiation.
